name: Stable Diffusion 1.5
summary: A small, general-purpose image model that runs on almost any graphics card.
details: The model Atlas’s Create package is built on. It makes pictures of about 512 to 768 pixels on a side in a broad, painterly range of styles (not photographic perfection), which Atlas’s upscaling can then enlarge. It is the lightest way to get real AI image making, and the base for Atlas’s tile-ControlNet editing.
